target.statement: AUC-PR of 89.4% on the Thyroid dataset (best result in Table 1)

compute.basis: Thyroid is a small dataset (3,772 samples, 6 attributes); training a small MLP with two-head attention for 100 epochs on CPU should take a few minutes per trial, and three trials plus setup fit well within 30 minutes.

title: Disentangling Tabular Data Towards Better One-Class Anomaly Detection
